top_story: As Gaza passes 1,000 days since 7 October 2023, the blockade and repeated Israeli strikes are compounding into a deeper civilian collapse: people displaced to beach tents were bombed on 25 June, and doctors now face forcing breast cancer patients into immediate mastectomies because the health system can no longer sustain timely treatment. The regional takeaway is that battlefield actions are hardening public sentiment and political mobilization across borders, even as the heaviest burden falls on civilians trapped in systems already pushed past collapse.
